lines.en: My belly nearly drags on the grass.
I sway along, step by step.
I shuffle along the mud's edge.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草压平了。
lines.en: The grass flattens where I walk.
I head for the water.
I shift into the shade.
I take two steps and rest.
I go slowly your way.
I push through the reeds.
I plod through the shallows.
I chew grass as I walk.
I root my nose in the mud.
I turn and head back.
I step down to the water.
I shuffle into the shade to doze.
I lie there without moving.
I doze with half-closed eyes.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子还在一动一动。
lines.en: My nose keeps twitching.
I stay in the shade.
I rest my head on the mud.
I chew my cud slowly.
I cannot be bothered to look up.
I daze by the water.
I listen to the river.
I close my eyes, peaceful.
My body rises and falls with breath.
I lie beside my kin.
I blink once from where I lie in the grass.
My nose twitches twice.
You are standing in my shade.
I lift my head from the water to look at you.
I shift a little toward you.
I glance at you and lie back down.
My eyes are gentle.
I sniff the grass smell on you.
I walk slowly over to you.
I startle and back off.
My whole body shudders.
I make a sound, not loud.
I retreat to the water.
My nose twitches.
I lie down and shrink a little.

lines.zh: 打扰一只打盹的水豚，很不礼貌。
lines.en: Waking a napping capybara is very impolite.

lines.zh: 好困，连挨打都想睡过去。
lines.en: So sleepy that even being hit makes me want to doze off.
I lift my head and my nose works.
I take it and chew slowly.
I chew with my eyes half shut.
I look up for another.
I drag it to the water to eat.
I finish and flop down.
I press it into the mud.
I chew contentedly.
I even lick your fingers.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子拱到你手心里。
lines.en: I push my nose into your palm.
I grunt as I eat.
I rub your leg when I finish.
You bump me and I wobble.
I yield a little.
I rub against your leg.
We bump, and it is soft.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪，又贴着草趴下
lines.en: I shift a little and flop back into the grass.
You step on my back.
I do not mind at all.
I flop back down.
Two capybaras lean together.
I groom behind its ear.
We soak in the water together.
Its head rests on my back.
We chew grass together.
Our bodies lie warm together.
We close our eyes together.
I shift over to lean on it.
They doze together by the water.
I take it in my mouth.
I chew twice and swallow slowly.
I lift it up and look.
I root it into the mud with my nose.
It drops from my mouth.
I push it to a stone.
I roll it along with my nose.
I give it to my kin.
I raise my head and look.
Something moves over there.
I push myself up.
I shuffle two slow steps forward.
My nose keeps sniffing.
I am not afraid, only curious.
I have found that smell.
I lower my head a little.
I am watching whether it comes closer.
I watch that way with half-closed eyes.
I follow that movement slowly.
It moves and I turn my head.
I am neither fast nor sneaking.
I keep heading that way.
I circle around the reeds.
It backs off and I do not chase.
I do not like conflict.
I raise my head a bit.
I shift two blocks slowly.
I butt it once.
I shove it off to one side.
I butt it once.
I press on it, heavy.
It is squeezed into the mud.
I shake my head with force.
I back off and lie down.
My teeth graze it.
I slowly push it away.

lines.zh: 水边多了一团圆身子的东西。
lines.en: A round shape appears by the water.
I shift out of the reeds.
A line of prints appears in the mud.
I begin walking by the river.
I come slowly out of the shade.

lines.zh: 这里多了一只很淡定的家伙。
lines.en: Something very calm has appeared here.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子先从草里探出。
lines.en: My nose comes out of the grass first.
I walk to the water and stop.
A smell of grass enters the air.

lines.zh: 火让我慌了，我跑向水里。
lines.en: Fire panics me and I run for the water.

lines.zh: 我从岸上滚下去，摔进泥里。
lines.en: I roll off the bank into the mud.
I choke once in the water.

lines.zh: 爆声把我吓得钻进芦苇。
lines.en: The blast sends me into the reeds.
The arrow shaves off a tuft of coarse hair.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我连动都不想动。
lines.en: That force leaves me unwilling to move.

lines.zh: 我饿得连嚼草的力气都没。
lines.en: Hunger leaves me too weak to chew.

lines.zh: 雷声把我整只压在地上。
lines.en: The thunder flattens me.

lines.zh: 下面的地没了，我一直掉。
lines.en: The ground is gone; I keep falling.
